Big Damn Heroes: She saves Earth-Natsu and his team from a giant frog when they're stillBrought Down to Normal.

characters.name: Natsu Dragyon
characters.description: Natsu Dragneel's Edolas counterpart. Unlike his Earth-land self, this Natsu shines while riding vehicles, and is Fairy Tail's transportation expert known as "Natsu the Fireball". Once he steps out of a vehicle, however, he turns into a sniveling wimp. Aggressive Submissive:Inverted. When he's out of a car, Edo-Lucy dominates Edo-Natsu as he's a frequent victim of her wrestling moves and he never fights her back.100 Years Questimplies he's much...differentwhen they'realone in a cargiven how she blushes when she mentions how "extreme" he gets. Badass Driver: He's about as badass behind the wheel as when Earth-Natsuisn'tin one. Catchphrase: "Go, fire!" Cool Sword: His weapon is a magic sword in the manga. In the anime, it's switched to aBattle Boomerang.

characters.name: Gray Sorloge
characters.description: Gray Fullbuster's Edolas counterpart. He wears layers upon layers of clothing, and has a very one-sided attraction to Edolas' Juvia. Cowardly Lion: He's terrified of the royal kingdom, but ultimately helps in the fight in the end. Dogged Nice Guy: As a result of Earth-Gray's and Earth-Juvia's roles being switched, Edo-Gray is completely and hopelessly head-over-heels in love with Edo-Juvia who only finds him annoying and turns him down whenever he tries joining her in a job.Though100 Years Questreveals it paid off. Inconsistent Spelling: Despite his Japanese name being pronounced something akin to "soh-ROOJ", his surname is commonly spelled as "Surge". Official Couple:100 Years Questreveals over the last nine years, he and Juvia finally tied the knot and even had a son.

characters.name: Wendy
characters.description: Wendy Marvell's Edolas counterpart, and a fully grown woman. Buxom Beauty Standard: Her huge chest is purely to provide a source ofA-Cup Angstfor Earth-Wendy. The Cynic: Rather mild example, but she told her younger self to give up on saving her friends and not go up against the kingdom, at least at first. Dual Wielding: She wields two knives in the manga. In the anime, they're changed to tonfas. I Got Bigger: She is a glimpse of what 12-year-old Wendy could look like as an adult.

characters.name: Mirajane
characters.description: Mirajane Strauss's Edolas counterpart, who acts the exact same way as she does in Earth-land. Cleavage Window: The only way in which Edo-Mirajane differs from Earth-land!Mira is that she far less conservatively dressed. Cool Big Sis: She's a sweet and caring sister to both Elfman and Lisanna, just like in Earth-land. In Spite of a Nail: Mirajane is the sole resident of Edolas who behaves exactly the same way as her Earth-land counterpart currently does. The difference is Edo-Mirajane hasalwaysacted like this, whereas the latter is aFormer Teen Rebel. Secret Secret-Keeper: She and Elfman figured out Earth-Lisanna wasn't their real sister, but they couldn't bring themselves to let her know that because Lisanna was doing it for their sakes.

characters.name: Elfman
characters.description: Elfman Strauss's Edolas counterpart. He's something of a wimp, and gets bullied by his stronger guildmates. Cowardly Lion: Despite being a weakling, he helps fight off the royal military. Gentle Giant: He's just as big as Earth-land Elfman, and completely soft-hearted. Good Scars, Evil Scars: Just like his Earth-land counterpart. Secret Secret-Keeper: Like Mirajane, he knew that Earth-land's Lisanna was impersonating their real, dead sister for some time.

characters.name: Juvia
characters.description: Juvia Lockser's Edolas counterpart, who can't stand Gray. Aloof Dark-Haired Girl: Contrary to Earth-land Juvia, her Edolas counterpart is aloof and detached towards her admirer, Gray. Curtains Match the Window: Blue hair, blue eyes. Defrosting Ice Queen: When she shows up again in100 Years Quest, Edo-Juvia seems to have warmed up to Edo-Gray over the yearsenough to marry him even. Jerkass: Unlike her Earth-land counterpart, she is very foul-tempered towards everyone,Grayin particular.

characters.name: Other Members
characters.description: Adapted Out: During the guild's first scene in the manga, Vijeeter was shown to have a counterpart telling Nab to take a day off once in a while. He was not included in the anime, and his line was given to Warren. Good Scars, Evil Scars: Jet, Droy and Elfman (the latter just like his Earth-land counterpart). The Ingenue: Cana is aProper Ladywith refined manners and elegance, unlike the boozehound her Earthland counterpart is. Jerkass: Levy, Jet, and Droy. The latter two are constantly picking on Elfman. No Shirt, Long Jacket: Jet and Droy.

characters.name: Exceed in General
characters.description: Back for the Finale: The Exceeds return to lend their magic power to a continent-wide link used to aid the casting of Fairy Sphere against Acnologia. Big Damn Heroes: They help Fairy Tail save the day at the end of the series by lending their magic powers to defeat Acnologia. The Bus Came Back: With Extalia gone, the Exceeds leave to establish a new settlement upon coming to Earth-land and aren't seen again for quite some time until the finale. They show up once more in a side novel, where Happy protects their village. Cat Folk: They may look like cats, but they act, dress, and run a society just like any human would. Cats Are Magic: Exceed are the only creatures in Edolas capable of harboring magic energy as an ability. This helps lend some credibility to them being viewed by humans as a divine race.

characters.name: Chagot
characters.description: The queen of Extalia and mother of Carla, revered as a god in Edolas. Barefoot Cartoon Animal: Just like the other Exceed, she doesn't wear any shoes. Broken Angel: Insofar as the Exceed are only superficially divine beings in Edolas, Chagot turns out to be this, having only a single wing. Dirty Business: Although she acted like an all-powerful god to protect her people, she deeply regretted all the misery she caused to those who were exiled, such as Happy's parents, Panther Lily, and her own daughter. God Guise: She conned everybody into thinking she is a god. Part of the trick was that she could see into the future and predict when people would die, which convinced everyone into thinking she could cause their deaths.

characters.name: Nichiya
characters.description: Ichiya's counterpart from Edolas, Nichiya is a member of Extalia's royal guard with the rank of Captain. After coming to Earth-land, he joins Blue Pegasus as the guild's "secret weapon" for the Grand Magic Games, disguising himself in a rabbit costume. Abhorrent Admirer: He's no different from Ichiya in this regard towards Erza, who is horrified by the knowledge that there are two Ichiyas. Alternate Species Counterpart: Nichya is a counterpart to Edolas. And I Must Scream: Gets turned into a lacrima with the rest of Extalia's army as one of the first victims of Faust'sEnemy Civil Warin Edolas after Code ETD gets executed. He is eventually returned to normal, though. Anti-Villain: He pursues Happy and Carla when they refuse to carry out the Dragon Slayer mission, but only to hide that the mission is all just part of a ruse devised to prevent a panic.

characters.name: Nadi
characters.description: Extalia's long-necked Minister of State. Cats Are Mean: He was in charge of the program that sent Happy and Carla to Earth-land to kill Dragon Slayers, and claims to kill other humans on command. However, this is all just a lie to keep humans in check which, considering Faust, is not that bad of an idea. All in all, he's a pretty nice guy. Character Tics: He never stops pumping his right fist into the air. It's so contagious that Natsu and his friends pick it up temporarily. Dissonant Serenity: He smiles cheerfully while talking about how humans are inferior and how the Exceeds kill them when their population grows too much. Of course, this is just part of the facade. Jerk with a Heart of Gold: He poses as an arrogant jerk who looks down on humans just so he can maintain peace among his people.

characters.name: Lucky and Marl
characters.description: A Exceed farmer couple who were labeled as "Fallen" and exiled from Extalia. They shelter Happy and Carla while they're on the run in Edolas. They're also Happy's parents. Casting Gag: The two share the same seiyuus with the two main leads ofRave Master, Haru and Elie. The Exile: They were exiled from Extalia because they objected to sending Happy's egg out to Earth-land. Happily Married: Although Lucky has a bad temper, they don't get into any fights and seem quite happy together. Long-Lost Relative: They are Happy's parents, although he directly doesn't know this.

characters.name: Characters / Fairy Tail – Natsu and Lucy
characters.description: Adaptation Dye-Job: His hair is reddish in the manga, but more pink in the anime. Admitting to Fear: Natsu has admitted to being afraid on a few occasions.During the S-Class exams, Natsu finds himself having to face against Gildarts. Natsu, loving the idea of having to fight the guild's most powerful wizard, demands Gildarts to show his full power, claiming to not be afraid. Gildarts obliges, and the intensity of his aura is enough to admit defeat in fear without throwing a punch. This display is enough for Gildarts to tell Natsu he passes his test for knowing when not to fight.During the same arc, Natsu finds himself up against Grimoire Heart's fire god slayer, Zancrow. He shows to have taken the lesson he learned from Gildarts to heart as he admits to feeling fear in this situation, but he makes it clear he will not let that stop him from protecting those he cares about, fighting Zancrow after witnessing him hurt Makarov. During the S-Class exams, Natsu finds himself having to face against Gildarts. Natsu, loving the idea of having to fight the guild's most powerful wizard, demands Gildarts to show his full power, claiming to not be afraid. Gildarts obliges, and the intensity of his aura is enough to admit defeat in fear without throwing a punch. This display is enough for Gildarts to tell Natsu he passes his test for knowing when not to fight. During the same arc, Natsu finds himself up against Grimoire Heart's fire god slayer, Zancrow. He shows to have taken the lesson he learned from Gildarts to heart as he admits to feeling fear in this situation, but he makes it clear he will not let that stop him from protecting those he cares about, fighting Zancrow after witnessing him hurt Makarov. Affectionate Gesture to the Head: As part of his ongoingShip Teasewith Lucy, he's prone to doing this as his way of giving her comfort. Hated Item Makeover: When Natsu first meets Zeref on Sirius Island, Zeref's death curse activates with Natsu only surviving thanks to his scar

characters.name: Characters / Fairy Tail – Juvia Lockser
characters.description: 11th-Hour Superpower: Juvia had secretly devised Water-Make: Blood in case Gray was ever in mortal danger, and she uses the spell to transfer her own blood to Gray and save his life. Abhorrent Admirer: She serves as one to Gray. While she is a very attractive young woman, Juvia's clingy and forward behavior towards Gray does more torepel than attract him to her. She slowly grows out of this trope once Gray starts to show signs that he has feelings for her later in the series. Accent Adaptation: The Tagalog and Animax English dubs give hera French accent. Adaptational Attractiveness: Downplayed. In her first manga appearance, Juvia was drawn with exaggerated features, a caricatural design, and a very scrawny frame. In the anime adaptation, her design was smoothed out, giving her a more conventionally attractive appearance with a normal, if serious and stern, demeanor. Act of True Love: During the Battle of Fairy Tail arc, when Fried traps Juvia and Cana inside a magical barrier that forces them to fight each other, Juvia chooses to attack the lacrima barrier itself, causing her own body great harm in the process. This act proves not only her loyalty but also the depth of her love for Fairy Tail, valuing her comrades over her own safety. Cana, moved by Juvia’s selflessness, breaks down in tears. Earn Your Happy Ending: After everything she went through for Gray, Juvia finally gets the man of her dreams at the end of the story. Eating the Eye Candy: Juvia enjoys ogling at Gray, especially when he unconsciously strips. Elemental Eye Colors: Juvia has dark blue eyes, and she specializes in water magic. Elemental Hair Colors: She's a water mage with blue hair. Also, her blue eyes make her count forElemental Eye Colorstoo. Elemental Motifs: Water, matchingher magicand being the source of herDark and Troubled Pastgiven the constant rain she caused. Like her element, Juvia's personality can vary greatly from person to person, beingexceedinglyfriendly to Gray, and hostile to
